CustomField.description: The surgeon's name as a link that opens this ROSA Surgeon record (the Surgeon Name field opens the surgeon's account instead). Used as the first column of the deal's ROSA Surgeons list.
CustomField.label: ROSA Surgeon
CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK("/" & Id, IF(ISBLANK(Surgeon_Name__c), Name, IF(Surgeon_Name__r.IsPersonAccount, TRIM(Surgeon_Name__r.FirstName & " " & Surgeon_Name__r.LastName), Surgeon_Name__r.Name)), "_self")
